name: Telluric-Paean

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a binary sunset, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the buried megastructure left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium, silicon and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
